REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, December 10, 2014 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy - Lomita Station
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular City Council Meetings held on November 12, 2014.
MOTION: That the minutes be approved.

c.

MOTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.

MOTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7i
j.
Authorize the City Manager to execute an Agreement with Omega Contractors in the amount of $167,831 for the Lomita Park Playground Surfacing Project
MOTION #1: Award a Public Works Agreement to Omega Contractors in the amount of $167,831 for the Lomita Park Playground Surfacing Project.
MOTION #2: Approve a total project budget of $184,641.10 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions).
MOTION #3: Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement with Omega Contractors.
Item 7j
k.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% Retention Payment in the Amount of $6,278.46 to Atlas-Allied, Inc., for the Water Meter Replacement Project - Phase I
MOTION #1: To accept the work performed by Atlas-Allied, Inc.; and
MOTION #2: Authorize the City Clerk to file the attached Notice of Completion (NOC) with the Los Angeles County Recorder's Office; and
MOTION #3 Authorize the Director of Public Works to sign the NOC and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $6,278.46 to Atlas-Allied, Inc., 35 calendar days after recordation of the Notice of Completion by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond.
Item 7k
l.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% Retention Payment in the Amount of $15,597.99 to All American Asphalt for the 254th Street Water Main Replacement and Pavement Rehabilitation Project from Narbonne Avenue to Feijoa Avenue and 241st Street Pavement Rehabilitation Project from Narbonne Avenue to Pennsylvania Avenue
Item 7l
m.
Acceptance of a donation from the Lomita Railroad Foundation - a 501(3c) non-profit organization in the amount of $7,000 to paint the yellow caboose at the Lomita Railroad Museum
MOTION: Accept the donation of $7,000 from the Lomita Railroad Museum Foundation Fund.
Item 7m
n.
Acceptance of Grant Funds from the BNSF Railroad Foundation in the amount of $1,500 for the painting of the yellow caboose at the Lomita Railroad Museum
MOTION: Accept the grant of $1,500 from BSNF Railway Foundation.
Item 7n
o.
Approval of a Resolution No. 2014-42 adopting an Amended Conflict of Interest Code for the City of Lomita pursuant to the Political Reform Act of 1974
MOTION: That Resolution No. 2014-42 be adopted amending the Conflict of Interest Code pursuant to the Political Reform Act of 1974.
Item 7o
p.
Adopt Ordinance No. 772 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending the Lomita Municipal Code by replacing Chapter 6 of Title II relating to purchasing and supplies with a revised Chapter 6 (Second Reading)
MOTION: That said Ordinance No. 772 be adopted.
Item 7p
q.
Distribution of $10,932 raised from the Mayor's Cup Golf Tournament to Recreation Services Youth Programs account
MOTION: That the amount of $10,932 be distributed to various recreation programs as outlined in the staff report.
Item 7q
r.
Consideration of Resolution No. 2014-43, approving Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with the Lomita City Employees Association (LCEA) Administrative and Field Services Unit Relative to Salary and Benefits
MOTION: Adopt the resolution and approve the MOUs.

MOTION Adopt the resolution and approve the Agreement.

MOTION: Adopt the resolution.
Item 7t
u.

MOTION: Adopt the resolution.
Item 7u
v.
Consideration of Resolution No. 2014-47, amending the Employer Paid Member Contributions for Tier 1 City Employees (hired prior to February 19, 2012) under the California Public Employees' Retirement System
MOTION: Adopt the resolution.
Item 7v
w.
Approval of Final Map for Tract No. 71769 for a 16 Unit Residential Project located at 26035 Cypress Street
That the City Council make the following findings:
MOTION #1: That the subdivider has met and performed all applicable requirements with the previously imposed pursuant to the State Subdivision Map Act (Government Code Section 66410, et seq.) and the City's subdivision ordinances; and
MOTION #2: That the proposed subdivision is in substantial compliance with the previously approved tentative map; and
Item 7w

DISCUSSION REGARDING A DRAFT FIVE YEAR WATER RATE STUDY AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION SETTING A RATE HEARING FOR FEBRUARY 11, 2015 Recommendations:
1.
Review the draft water rates; and
2.
Direct staff to send out the public notice for the water rate hearing; and
3.
Conduct the rate hearing on February 11, 2015, after the 45 day public notice period. Presented by Brian Jewett, Black & Veatch
Item 8
9.

1.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer Engineers and Scientists in the amount $9,880 for a Feasibility Study to Connect Pressure Zone 2 to the DWPF; and
2.
Approve a total budget of $11,856 (which includes a 20% contingency for unforeseen scope/conditions) Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy
Item 9
10.

1.
Authorize the creation of a new capital project Harbor Hills Housing Development Water System Direct Meter Project; and
2.
Authorize a project budget of $70,000 utilizing savings from the Harbor Hills Water Storage Tank Rehabilitation Project. Presented by Public Works Director McAvoy

Presented by City Manager Rock

Presented by City Manager Rock

15.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on January 14, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
